question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as public core config/plugin API, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main proves the single-slot limitation, but the proposed fix adds durable config, plugin API, per-agent semantics, and migration obligations that automation should not choose.

options.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the taxonomy first
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work and ask the PR to reduce or rename role slots before public config surface lands.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide memory composition should stay outside core or use a different plugin API shape.
